name: request_user_input
description: Ask the user one focused question. The call returns immediately: after it, ask the question in your final response and stop the turn. Use it when you are genuinely blocked: only the user can make the decision; required input is missing; the action is risky or irreversible; an ambiguous or broad request has two materially different readings that would change contracts, persisted data, user-visible identity, or blast radius; or a consequential conclusion needs information only the user can provide (intent, preferences, requirements, unstated constraints). Before asking, exhaust what tools and verification can establish — never skip autonomous investigation just because asking is allowed. Do not ask about routine details; when a local, reversible choice has a clearly narrower reading, take it, state the assumption, and proceed. Keep the tool-call turn's assistant text empty (just call the tool), so the same content is not shown twice. When a skill is active, the driver restores that skill only for the user's immediately following normal message; an explicit skill selection overrides it.

question.description: The concise information, decision, or confirmation needed from the user.
